title: Israel strikes Beirut days after US-brokered truce
narrative: On June 7 2026, Israel launched airstrikes on Beirut's southern suburbs, claiming the attacks were ordered "in response to Hezbollah's firing at Israeli territory." This comes days after a US-brokered ceasefire deal was announced. Iran immediately threatened a "painful" response. The US has publicly characterized the ceasefire as holding, while the UK and European allies have urged restraint. Israel frames the strikes as defensive retaliation.
